workspaceId.description: The workspace to read. If you do not send it, the server uses the workspace of your token. You must be a member of the workspace.

page.description: The page to return. The default is 1.

perPage.description: The number of issues on a page. The default is 50.

orderBy.description: The field that sets the order, highest value first. The default is updatedAt.

view.description: The shape of each issue. list gives a short row with no description. full gives all the fields of the issue and descriptionMarkdown. The default is list.
